answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1515 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the canyon. The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the zephyr queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 326 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
